## Speaker
Chen Wei

### Theme
An Invitation to Topological Orders and Category Theory (3)

### Abstract
We explore how anyonic excitations (or particle‑like topological defects) are organized into unitary modular tensor categories, whose braiding data encode fractional and non‑abelian statistics. The nondegeneracy condition, captured by the Müger center, is shown to be equivalent to anomaly freedom, guaranteeing a consistent definition on closed manifolds. This framework provides a complete and rigorous classification of 2d topological orders.
